title: SIMULATION: Local settlement desks, paid for by landlords
answer: Claims rose 21% in July to September (s1). In this simulation, landlords would fund local settlement desks through a charge on each rented home, barred from being added to rent. Local tenants and landlords would elect equal numbers to steer each desk and hire independent advisers. Tenants could seek a voluntary payment plan or agreed moving date, with advice of their own. Refusing a deal would not weaken anyone's right to a court hearing. Landlords would carry the financial wait; tenants would stay until lawful eviction. After six months, measure court waiting times, agreements kept and homelessness after cases. Publish the results locally.
